'''2001 Brugge Belgian Open Juliën Riviëre DS''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Juliën Riviëre]]
* '''Event:''' [[2001 Brugge Belgian Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Published lists
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif|label=Ralltiir Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Ralltiir Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTat ROps Riviere DS 2001 Brugge.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Juliën Riviëre from France had opponents flying to and fro, but went unbeaten all weekend in Brugge's Belgian Open. He landed the first spot in Saturday's 54-player constructed event and was part of the winning "The Four Mouseketeers" Team in Sunday's 57-player Team event. This ROps DS-decks is one of the tools that got him those victories.
